name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.descent_point
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (L σ gamma : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g σ →
        0 ≤ gamma →
          ∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => f (x - gamma • g y b)) ↑μ ∧
              ∫ (b : Ω), f (x - gamma • g y b) ∂↑μ ≤
                f x - gamma / 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 - gamma / 2 * (1 - L * gamma) * ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2 +
                    gamma * L ^ 2 / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 +
                  gamma ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2
